# ROAL Mobileri

> Custom furniture in Tirana, Albania. ROAL designs, makes and installs kitchens, fitted wardrobes, bedrooms, living-room cabinetry, workspaces and hospitality interiors. Projects start with the client's ideas, everyday needs and budget.

ROAL Mobileri (RO-AL SH.P.K) has a workshop and showroom at Km 8 on the Tirana–Durrës highway. Clients compare materials and mechanisms, review a 3D design and receive a detailed quote before production. Consultation, measurement and 3D design are free. The team handles installation across Albania, with a 2-year warranty on each build.

This is a summary of information available on the website. Project prices and timelines are confirmed individually; there is no published fixed price list.

## Planning a project

- Start with an idea, a photo, a floor plan or approximate dimensions, and the budget you have in mind.
- Discuss how the room will be used, compare samples and agree on the layout and materials.
- Review the free 3D design and detailed quote before approving production.
- Prices depend on dimensions, materials, finishes, worktops, mechanisms, lighting and installation complexity. Compare what is included in each quote, including appliances and services.
- Projects typically take 3–6 weeks after design approval. Exact timing is confirmed after material selection.
- Bank instalment options are available through partners; ask ROAL about the options for your project.
- A project may be a single piece, a small kitchen or a complete interior.
